description: This Kotlin source file defines a class 'NotificationPermissionHandler' that manages notification permission requests and checks within an Android app. It handles permission checking, requesting permissions at runtime, and logging permission-related events via an analytics manager.

classes.name: NotificationPermissionHandler
classes.description: Handles notification permission requests and checks, including requesting permissions, logging events, and scheduling notifications upon permission grant.

methods.name: hasNotificationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has notification permission granted.

methods.name: requestNotificationPermission
methods.description: Requests notification permission at runtime if not already granted.

methods.name: onPermissionResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the permission request, logs the outcome, and schedules notifications if granted.

methods.description: Singleton pattern to obtain an instance of NotificationPermissionHandler.
